name: time-anchor
description: A relational local-time anchor with an optional ambient hook.

interface.shortDescription: Bring lived time into conversational continuity.
interface.longDescription: Adds a conditional active clock check and an optional user hook. The hook keeps timestamps separate by conversation and supplies ambient time on an independent one-in-four draw.
defaultPrompt: Use $time-anchor:time-anchor when elapsed time may change what this message means.
